post.description: Fetches an arbitrary http(s) URL once, parses it as a feed and reports the title, item count and up to three recent items, so the caller sees what would be matched before committing. Transport and parse problems are reported in `error` using a closed vocabulary with a 200 response; upstream error text and response bodies are never echoed. Private, loopback and link-local targets are refused without issuing a request. Subject to the tighter write/probe rate limit.

info.title: FeedPulse API
info.description: HTTP API for registering RSS/Atom feeds and keyword rules, inspecting the entries and alerts they produce, and reading operational health.

tags.description: Alert inspection and manual delivery APIs.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, lower snake_case.

path.description: Request path that produced the error.

requestId.description: Correlation id, echoed back in the `x-request-id` response header.

title.example: Council approves the new housing plan

reachable.description: True when the origin answered with a status below 400 after following redirects.

latencyMs.description: Round-trip time of the probe in milliseconds.

itemCount.description: Items found in the parsed feed.

sampleItems.description: Up to three of the most recent items, so the caller sees what would be matched.

error.description: Closed error vocabulary. `null` means the URL was fetched and parsed as a feed. Upstream error text is never echoed.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL to probe. It does not have to be registered as a feed.

status.description: `already_queued` means the feed currently holds a scheduler claim, i.e. a fetch is already in flight.

include_keywords.description: Each item is matched as a full normalized phrase (accent-insensitive, contiguous text). Max 20 items, 200 characters each.

exclude_keywords.description: Blocks alerts when a full normalized phrase is present. Max 20 items, 200 characters each.

created.description: Rules that were newly created by this request.

skippedNames.description: Names left untouched because the tenant already had a rule with that name.

duplicateNames.description: Names the request listed more than once. Only the first occurrence was used.

rules.description: Rules to create. Create-only: a name the tenant already uses is reported back untouched, never overwritten.

include_keywords.description: Each item is matched as a full normalized phrase (accent-insensitive, contiguous text). Max 20 items, 200 characters each.

exclude_keywords.description: Blocks alerts when a full normalized phrase is present. Max 20 items, 200 characters each.
